name: ConverseNow
oneLiner: Voice AI for restaurant phone and drive-thru ordering: virtual assistants take orders in natural conversation, upsell, and send orders straight into the POS.
bestFor: Pizza, wings and other QSR or fast-casual chains with heavy phone or drive-thru order volume that want to automate order taking across many locations.

updates.text: Partnership and integration with Deliverect, so restaurants can plug ConverseNow's voice AI ordering for phone and drive-thru into Deliverect's order and menu management.

features: AI voice assistant that answers restaurant phone lines and takes full orders
Drive-thru voice ordering (strengthened by the 2024 Valyant AI acquisition)
Orders sent directly into the POS, with no re-keying by staff
Consistent, automatic upsell suggestions on every order
Generative AI (large language model) conversation for natural back-and-forth
Hand-off option to a human agent through call-center partner OrderSolutions
Integration with Deliverect order and menu management

pricing.text: Custom pricing; ConverseNow does not publish prices.
